title: A transfer's `a` is what left, fee included; the fee record moves only the place, never the account (decision T, S5 fix)
story: In pesos. Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027: the bank holds 20,000.00, of which 3,000.00 is what is left of Free to spend (typed); an e-wallet holds nothing. Pay of 30,000.00 on the 25th (moved earlier); Free to spend is 5,000.00 a month. Tue 5 Jan: a top-up of 1,015.00 out and 1,000.00 in, with its 15.00 fee record; the top-up is undone on one phone, and the fee record's undo has not come across yet. Wed 20 Jan: a second top-up, the same, with its fee record. Every amount is made up.

events.note: its fee record; the undo has not come across

asks.why: 20,000.00 (opening; the top-up was undone, and a fee record never moves the account) = 20,000.00
asks.note: Before the S5 fix a fee record whose transfer was gone became a plain spend: 19,985.00.
